name: shuffle-fixes
title: Shuffle Fixes
summary: Corrects four errors in the shuffle.
details: Shuffle operates correctly with more than 32767 songs.
The shuffle does not use the position after the end of the list.
Three rare start values do not stop the shuffle.
The shuffle of the songs in each album uses the correct positions.
notes: With 32767 songs or fewer, the same start value gives the same order as before.

steps: Put more than 32767 songs on the iPod.
Flash a firmware with this patch.
On the iPod, select Shuffle Songs.
Make sure that Now Playing shows "1 of" and the full count of songs.
Push Next many times. Each song must play.
Select Shuffle Songs again. Do not push Next.
Let the first song play to its end. The second song must start.
